$comment: Public API of every Curated SDK binding. scripts/check-public-api.py fails CI when this list and the binding sources differ. docs/reference pages are generated from it. Keys are member names as the extractor (scripts/public_api.py) reports them; values are one-line descriptions shown on docs.curated.games.

dotnet.Achievement: One achievement defined for the current app.
dotnet.Achievement.Achievement: Create a handle for the achievement with this name (matches admin Achievements tool).
dotnet.Achievement.Name: Stable name used when unlocking (same string you configure in admin).
dotnet.Achievement.DisplayName: Player-facing title when progress has been loaded; otherwise equals `Name`.
dotnet.Achievement.Description: Player-facing description when progress has been loaded.
dotnet.Achievement.State: True when the local player has unlocked this achievement.
dotnet.Achievement.UnlockedAt: When the achievement was unlocked, if known.
dotnet.Achievement.TriggerAsync: Unlock this achievement for the local player. Safe to call more than once. Returns true when this call newly unlocked it.
dotnet.Achievements: List and unlock achievements for the initialized app.
dotnet.Achievements.All: Achievements for this app after `RefreshAsync`. Empty until refresh succeeds.
dotnet.Achievements.RefreshAsync: Load achievement defs and unlock state from Curated.
dotnet.Achievements.TriggerAsync: Unlock by name. Equivalent to `new Achievement(name).TriggerAsync()`.
dotnet.Cloud: Cloud Save: sync local files on launch and quit.
dotnet.Cloud.SyncOnLaunchAsync: Call on game launch. Downloads newer Cloud Save files into `localFolder`.
dotnet.Cloud.SyncOnQuitAsync: Call on game quit. Uploads the listed relative paths under `localFolder`.
dotnet.CloudSyncResult: Outcome of a Cloud Save sync (paths that were transferred).
dotnet.CloudSyncResult.CloudSyncResult: Creates a result for the given transferred paths (the SDK creates these for you).
dotnet.CloudSyncResult.TransferredPaths: Relative paths that were uploaded or downloaded during this sync.
dotnet.CuratedClient: Initialize Curated once at game start, then call `Shutdown` on quit.
dotnet.CuratedClient.DefaultHubUrl: Default Curated hub used when Init is called without an explicit URL.
dotnet.CuratedClient.IsValid: True after a successful `InitAsync`, `InitFromLauncherAsync`, or `Init` (all of which verify ownership).
dotnet.CuratedClient.IsEntitled: True when Curated verified that the signed-in player owns `AppId` during init. Game-scoped APIs require this. False before init and after `Shutdown`.
dotnet.CuratedClient.Init: Start Curated for this game with a session token the game already holds, verify the player session, and confirm ownership of `appId`. Blocks until the hub responds. Prefer `InitAsync` or `InitFromLauncherAsync` from async game code (Unity main thread included). Throws if already initialized or arguments are invalid; throws `CuratedLaunchException` when the session is invalid or the player does not own the game.
dotnet.CuratedClient.InitAsync: Start Curated with a session token the game already holds, verify the player session, and confirm ownership of `appId`. On failure Curated is left shut down and a `CuratedLaunchException` carries the launch contract error code.
dotnet.CuratedClient.Session: The authenticated, entitled session after a successful `InitFromLauncherAsync`; otherwise null.
dotnet.CuratedClient.InitFromLauncherAsync: Start Curated from the launch variables the Curated launcher set on this process, verify the player session, and confirm the player owns `appId`. On failure Curated is left shut down and a `CuratedLaunchException` carries the launch contract error code.
dotnet.CuratedClient.InitWithAccountSessionAsyn: Verify an account session that was not injected as launch variables, then confirm the player owns `appId`. Used by the Unity Editor when Curated is already signed in on this machine. The token is sent only to `DefaultHubUrl`.
dotnet.CuratedClient.GetOpenIdIdTokenAsync: Mint a short-lived OpenID Connect ID token for the initialized session (`POST /auth/openid/id-token`). Pass the returned string only to the game's own OpenID Connect provider (for example Unity Authentication with provider `oidc-curated`). Never log it. Requires a prior `Init` or `InitFromLauncherAsync`.
dotnet.CuratedClient.GetCurrentGameLanguage: The game language the player selected in the Curated launcher, as a lowercase Curated code (`en`, `es`, `it`, and any other code in `GameLanguages.All`). It is the launcher's client language, the same one the launcher uses to pick language depots. Returns `en` when the game was not started by the launcher, the launcher did not send a language, or the language is not a Curated game language. Works before and without `InitFromLauncherAsync`. When porting from Steam, see `GetCurrentGameLanguageSteamApiName`.
dotnet.CuratedClient.GetCurrentGameLanguageStea: Migrating from Steam: `GetCurrentGameLanguage` as a Steam client language API name (`english`, `spanish`, `italian`, `brazilian`, ...). Returns `english` as the fallback.
dotnet.CuratedClient.OpenStoreOverlay: Open a published Curated store page in the launcher overlay. `OverlayToStoreFlag.None` opens the page with no cart action. `OverlayToStoreFlag.AddToCart` and `OverlayToStoreFlag.AddToCartAndShow` also add the app to the cart, and only for a released or preorderable app. Requires Curated to be initialized and the overlay to be enabled and active. Throws `CuratedException` with the launcher's English message on failure.
dotnet.CuratedClient.Shutdown: Shut down Curated and release network resources. Safe to call more than once.
dotnet.CuratedException: Curated rejected a client call (auth, entitlement, validation, or hub error).
dotnet.CuratedException.CuratedException: Creates the exception with the HTTP status and response body (thrown by the SDK).
dotnet.CuratedException.ResponseBody: Raw response body, when Curated sent one. Never contains the session token.
dotnet.CuratedLaunchError: Why a launch from the Curated launcher could not start a Curated session.
dotnet.CuratedLaunchError.NotLaunchedByCurated: Launch variables are missing. Contract code `not_launched_by_curated`.
dotnet.CuratedLaunchError.UnsupportedContractVe: Contract version is below the minimum this game still supports, or invalid. Contract code `unsupported_contract_version`.
dotnet.CuratedLaunchError.AppMismatch: The launch was for a different app. Contract code `app_mismatch`.
dotnet.CuratedLaunchError.SessionInvalid: The session expired or the player signed out. Contract code `session_invalid`.
dotnet.CuratedLaunchError.NotEntitled: The player does not own this app. Contract code `not_entitled`.
dotnet.CuratedLaunchError.NetworkError: No response from Curated. Contract code `network_error`.
dotnet.CuratedLaunchError.HubError: Curated returned an unexpected error. Contract code `hub_error`.
dotnet.CuratedLaunchException: Starting a Curated session from the launcher failed. See `Error`.
dotnet.CuratedLaunchException.CuratedLaunchExce: Creates the exception for a launch error (thrown by the SDK).
dotnet.CuratedLaunchException.Error: Launch error as an enum value.
dotnet.CuratedLaunchException.Code: Launch contract error code, identical across every Curated engine binding.
dotnet.CuratedLaunchException.ToCode: Shared contract error code string for a `CuratedLaunchError` (for example `not_entitled`).
dotnet.CuratedSession: Authenticated, entitled player session returned by `CuratedClient.InitFromLauncherAsync`.
dotnet.CuratedSession.AppId: App id the session was verified for.
dotnet.CuratedSession.CuratedId: Public Curated player id (`curated_id`, 17-digit decimal string).
dotnet.CuratedSession.Language: Raw `CURATED_LANGUAGE` value from the launcher (`en`, `es`, `it`), or null when the launcher did not send one. Prefer `CurrentGameLanguage`.
dotnet.CuratedSession.CurrentGameLanguage: Current game language as a Curated code, with the `en` fallback. Same value as `CuratedClient.GetCurrentGameLanguage`.
dotnet.CuratedSession.Entitlement: Ownership details read from `/library` during init.
dotnet.Entitlement: Whether the signed-in player owns the initialized app on Curated.
dotnet.Entitlement.IsEntitled: True when the player has an active entitlement for `AppId`.
dotnet.Entitlement.Source: How the copy was obtained: `primary`, `resale`, `grant`, or `bonus`.
dotnet.Entitlement.AcquiredAt: When the player acquired the game, when Curated reports it.
dotnet.Entitlements: Ownership checks for the initialized app.
dotnet.Entitlements.CheckAsync: Ask Curated whether the signed-in player still owns this app. Refunds, resales, and revocations deactivate entitlements, so long sessions may re-check periodically.
dotnet.Friend.Friend: Creates a friend row (the SDK creates these for you).
dotnet.Friend.Id: Curated user id of the friend.
dotnet.Friend.Name: Display name of the friend.
dotnet.Friend.RichText: Rich presence text the friend's game set, or empty.
dotnet.Friend.AppId: App id the friend is playing when `PresenceStatus` is `in_game`.
dotnet.Friends: Friends list and requests (helpers over Curated social).
dotnet.Friends.GetFriendsAsync: Accepted friends, with presence when available.
dotnet.Friends.RequestAsync: Send a friend request by username.
dotnet.GameLanguage: A Curated game language: canonical code and optional Steam client API name (for Migrating from Steam).
dotnet.GameLanguage.Code: Canonical lowercase Curated code, for example `en`, `it`, `pt-br`.
dotnet.GameLanguage.SteamApiName: Migrating from Steam: Steam client API language name (`english`, `brazilian`, `koreana`).
dotnet.GameLanguage.Aliases: Other codes accepted for this language (for example `zh` for `zh-cn`).
dotnet.GameLanguages: The languages `CuratedClient.GetCurrentGameLanguage` can return: the Full Platform languages of the Curated language catalog, the same codes depots use. `ToSteamApiName` / `FromSteamApiName` help when migrating from Steam.
dotnet.GameLanguages.DefaultLanguage: Returned when the language is unknown or the game was not started by the launcher.
dotnet.GameLanguages.All: Every supported game language, in catalog order.
dotnet.GameLanguages.Normalize: Canonical Curated code for `language`, which may be a Curated code, an alias, a BCP-47 tag (`pt-BR`, `it_IT`) or a Steam client API name (`italian`). Returns null when it is not a supported game language.
dotnet.GameLanguages.ToSteamApiName: Migrating from Steam: Steam client API language name (for example `english`, `brazilian`) for a Curated code or any value `Normalize` accepts. Returns null when the language is not supported.
dotnet.GameLanguages.FromSteamApiName: Migrating from Steam: Curated code for a Steam client API language name (for example `latam` to `es-419`), or null.
dotnet.LaunchContext: Values the Curated launcher sets on the game process (launch contract v1). Read with `FromEnvironment`; most games call `CuratedClient.InitFromLauncherAsync` instead.
dotnet.LaunchContext.SupportedContractVersion: Newest launch contract version this SDK fully implements. Informational only: launch accepts any version at or above `MinCompatibleContractVersion`.
dotnet.LaunchContext.MinCompatibleContractVersi: Oldest launch contract version this SDK still accepts. Raise this only when retiring an old contract; newer launcher versions stay accepted so shipped games keep working while their used features remain available.
dotnet.LaunchContext.LauncherVariable: `CURATED_LAUNCHER`: present and `1` when the Curated launcher started the game.
dotnet.LaunchContext.SessionTokenVariable: `CURATED_SESSION_TOKEN`: player session token. Secret, never log it.
dotnet.LaunchContext.ApiBaseVariable: `CURATED_API_BASE`: Curated API origin, the only destination for the token.
dotnet.LaunchContext.OverlayEndpointVariable: `CURATED_OVERLAY_ENDPOINT`: loopback address of the launcher overlay toast host.
dotnet.LaunchContext.OverlayTokenVariable: `CURATED_OVERLAY_TOKEN`: per-launch overlay secret. Never log it.
dotnet.LaunchContext.AppId: Curated app id the player launched.
dotnet.LaunchContext.ApiBase: API origin without a trailing slash.
dotnet.LaunchContext.UserIdHint: Player id hint from the launcher. The session call returns the authoritative value.
dotnet.LaunchContext.UsernameHint: Player display name hint from the launcher.
dotnet.LaunchContext.Language: Raw `CURATED_LANGUAGE` value: the launcher's client language (`en`, `es`, `it`), or null. `CuratedClient.GetCurrentGameLanguage` normalizes it and falls back to `en`.
dotnet.LaunchContext.IsLaunchedByCurated: True when the process looks like it was started by the Curated launcher.
dotnet.LaunchContext.FromEnvironment: Read and validate the launch variables of the current process for a game whose Curated app id is `expectedAppId`.
dotnet.LaunchContext.ApiBaseText: API origin as text, without a trailing slash.
dotnet.LocalAccountSession: Account session already signed in on this machine. The token is for the Curated API only and must not be logged.
dotnet.LocalAccountSession.TryReadToken: Token from the running Curated launcher's remembered session (`Config/session.json` beside `Curated.exe`), or from the content-builder credentials file. Null when neither is present.
dotnet.MicroTxnAuthorizationStatus: Outcome of a player authorization for one in-app purchase order.
dotnet.MicroTxnAuthorizationStatus.Authorized: The player authorized the order. The wallet reserve stays until the game server finalizes it.
dotnet.MicroTxnAuthorizationStatus.Denied: The player denied the order. The wallet reserve is released and the order is failed.
dotnet.MicroTxnAuthorizationStatus.Error: The launcher overlay is missing, the purchase could not be completed, or Curated rejected it. Not a player denial.
dotnet.MicroTxnAuthorization: Result of `MicroTxn.AuthorizeAsync`. Authorized and denied are player decisions. `MicroTxnAuthorizationStatus.Error` is a Curated failure, not a denial.
dotnet.MicroTxnAuthorization.OrderId: Order id from InitTxn. Echoed from the response when Curated sends one.
dotnet.MicroTxnAuthorization.TransId: Transaction id from InitTxn. Echoed from the response when Curated sends one.
dotnet.MicroTxnAuthorization.ErrorCode: Curated `errorcode` when `Status` is error; otherwise null.
dotnet.MicroTxnAuthorization.ErrorDescription: Curated `errordesc` when `Status` is error; otherwise null.
dotnet.MicroTxn: In-app purchases for the signed-in player. The game server creates the order with InitTxn and finalizes it with FinalizeTxn. This client only records the player's authorization. The publisher key is never read or sent.
dotnet.MicroTxn.AuthorizeAsync: Ask the Curated launcher overlay to confirm an order the game server created with InitTxn. Maps the overlay status to authorized, denied, or error. Outside the launcher the result is error. Does not POST a decision.
dotnet.OverlayToStoreFlag: What `CuratedClient.OpenStoreOverlay` should do with the cart.
dotnet.OverlayToStoreFlag.None: Open the store page. No cart action. Allowed for a published app, including one that is not released.
dotnet.OverlayToStoreFlag.AddToCart: Open the store page and add the app to the cart. Released or preorderable apps only.
dotnet.OverlayToStoreFlag.AddToCartAndShow: Add the app to the cart and show the cart. Released or preorderable apps only.
dotnet.Presence.SetAsync: Set your presence. Status is online, away, offline, or in_game. When status is in_game, the current app id from Init is sent automatically.
dotnet.Presence.HeartbeatAsync: Keep presence fresh while the game is running.
dotnet.Stat: One backend-defined player stat for the current app.
dotnet.Stat.Stat: Create a handle for the stat with this API name (matches admin Stats Configuration).
dotnet.Stat.Name: Stable API name used when setting or incrementing (same string as in admin).
dotnet.Stat.DisplayName: Player-facing title when progress has been loaded; otherwise equals `Name`.
dotnet.Stat.ValueType: Wire type from the backend: `int` or `float`.
dotnet.Stat.Value: Current value for the local player (after `Stats.RefreshAsync` or a mutate call).
dotnet.Stat.DefaultValue: Default value from the stat definition.
dotnet.Stat.IncrementOnly: When true, the backend rejects absolute sets that would decrease the value.
dotnet.Stat.SetBy: Who may write the value: `client` or `server`.
dotnet.Stat.Stored: False when `Value` is still the definition default (no `player_stats` row yet).
dotnet.StatUpdate: One entry for a batch stats store call (absolute value or delta).
dotnet.StatUpdate.Value: Absolute value to store, when set.
dotnet.StatWriteResult: Result of a single-stat SetStat or IncrementStat call.
dotnet.StatWriteResult.Delta: Applied delta for increment calls; null for absolute SetStat.
dotnet.StatWriteResult.UnlockedAchievements: Achievement API names newly unlocked by this write (may be empty).
dotnet.StatStoreResult: Result of a batch stats store call.
dotnet.StatStoreResult.Updated: Per-stat outcomes in request order when the hub returns them.
dotnet.StatStoreResult.UnlockedAchievements: Deduped achievement API names newly unlocked across the batch.
dotnet.Stats: Read and write backend-defined player stats for the initialized app (Steam-like GetStat / SetStat / StoreStats).
dotnet.Stats.All: Stats for this app after `RefreshAsync`. Empty until refresh succeeds.
dotnet.Stats.RefreshAsync: Load stat definitions and current player values from Curated.
dotnet.Stats.GetStat: Steam-style GetStat for an int-backed value from the local cache.
dotnet.Stats.TryGetStat: Read the cached numeric value, or false when the name is unknown locally.
dotnet.Stats.SetStat: Steam-style SetStat: update the local cache and mark the value dirty. Call `StoreStatsAsync` to push pending values to Curated.
dotnet.Stats.StoreStatsAsync: Steam-style StoreStats: POST pending local SetStat values to `/games/app/{app_id}/stats/store`.
dotnet.Stats.IncrementStatAsync: Increment a stat via `POST /games/app/{app_id}/stats/{api_name}/increment` with body `{ "delta": ... }`.

unity.CuratedLauncherBootstrap: Drop on a GameObject in the first scene to run the Curated launch check on startup.
unity.CuratedLauncherBootstrap.FailedEvent: UnityEvent carrying the launch contract error code.
unity.CuratedLauncherBootstrap.appId: This game's Curated app id (from the Curated developer admin).
unity.CuratedLauncherBootstrap.skipInEditor: In the Editor, connect to a running Curated launcher when possible, and keep playing if that connection fails.
unity.CuratedLauncherBootstrap.quitOnFailure: Quit the application when the check fails (not started by Curated, not owned, or expired session).
unity.CuratedLauncherBootstrap.onReady: Invoked once the player is signed in and owns the game. Read CuratedClient.Session for player details.
unity.CuratedLauncherBootstrap.onFailed: Invoked with the launch contract error code (for example not_entitled) when the check fails.
unity.CuratedUnity: Unity entry points for the Curated launch contract.
unity.CuratedUnity.InitFromLauncherAsync: Verify the Curated launcher session and ownership of `appId`, and shut Curated down automatically when the application quits. In the Unity Editor, send editor_attach to a running launcher without requiring `CURATED_LAUNCHER` or a process the launcher started. On success, the launcher draws its overlay on the Game view and this call does not throw `not_launched_by_curated`.
unity.CuratedUnity.InitWithAccountSessionAsync: Same checks as `InitFromLauncherAsync` for an account session read by the Editor. The token is sent only to the Curated API. In the Editor, editor_attach also lets the launcher draw its overlay on the Game view when the launcher accepts the signed-in account.
unity.CuratedUnity.GetOpenIdIdTokenAsync: Mint a short-lived OpenID Connect ID token for the initialized session. Pass it only to Unity Authentication (`SignInWithOpenIdConnectAsync` / `LinkWithOpenIdConnectAsync` with provider `oidc-curated`). Never log it. Same as `CuratedClient.GetOpenIdIdTokenAsync`.
unity.CuratedUnity.GetCurrentGameLanguage: Game language the player selected in the Curated launcher (`en`, `es`, `it`, ...), or `en` outside the launcher. Same as `CuratedClient.GetCurrentGameLanguage`.
unity.CuratedUnity.GetCurrentGameLanguageSteam: Migrating from Steam: Steam client language API name for `GetCurrentGameLanguage` (`english`, `spanish`, ...).
unity.CuratedUnity.OpenStoreOverlay: Open a published Curated store page in the launcher overlay. `OverlayToStoreFlag.None` opens the page with no cart action. `OverlayToStoreFlag.AddToCart` and `OverlayToStoreFlag.AddToCartAndShow` also add the app to the cart, and only for a released or preorderable app. Same as `CuratedClient.OpenStoreOverlay`.
unity.OverlayToStoreFlag: What `CuratedUnity.OpenStoreOverlay` should do with the cart. Values match `Curated.Sdk.OverlayToStoreFlag`.
unity.OverlayToStoreFlag.None: Open the store page. No cart action. Allowed for a published app, including one that is not released.
unity.OverlayToStoreFlag.AddToCart: Open the store page and add the app to the cart. Released or preorderable apps only.
unity.OverlayToStoreFlag.AddToCartAndShow: Add the app to the cart and show the cart. Released or preorderable apps only.

godot.Curated: Autoload registered by the Curated SDK plugin. Call it as `Curated` from any script.
godot.Curated.launch_completed: Emitted when `init_from_launcher` finishes, with the same result dictionary it returns.
godot.Curated.session: Authenticated, entitled session after a successful init_from_launcher, else {}.
godot.Curated.is_dedicated_server: True in exports made with the "Dedicated Server" preset; Curated never initializes there.
godot.Curated.init_from_launcher: Read launch variables, verify the session, and confirm ownership of `app_id`. Returns { ok = true, session } or { ok = false, error }. `env` and `transport` are for tests; transport is Callable(method, url, token) returning { status, text } or { network_error = true }.
godot.Curated.get_current_game_language: Game language the player selected in the Curated launcher, as a lowercase Curated code ("en", "es", "it", "pt-br", ...). It is the launcher's client language, the same one used to pick language depots. Returns "en" when the game was not started by the launcher, no language was sent, or it is not a Curated game language. Works before init_from_launcher. `env` is for tests.
godot.Curated.get_current_game_language_steam_: Migrating from Steam: get_current_game_language() as a Steam client language API name ("english", "spanish", "italian", ...).
godot.Curated.check_entitlement: Re-check ownership during a long session. Returns { ok, entitlement } or { ok = false, error }.
godot.Curated.unlock_achievement: Unlock an achievement by API name (idempotent). Returns { ok, newly_unlocked } or { ok = false, error }.
godot.Curated.refresh_stats: Load stat definitions and current player values. Returns { ok, stats } or { ok = false, error }.
godot.Curated.set_stat: SetStat absolute value. Returns { ok, stat, previous_value } or { ok = false, error }.
godot.Curated.increment_stat: Increment a player stat. Returns { ok, stat, previous_value } or { ok = false, error }.
godot.Curated.authorize_txn: Ask the Curated launcher overlay to confirm an order the game server created with InitTxn. Returns { ok, status, order_id, trans_id } where status is "authorized" or "denied", or { ok = false, status = "error", error, ... }. Sends one TCP line to CURATED_OVERLAY_ENDPOINT and reads microtxn_purchase_result. Outside the launcher the result is error. The game server calls FinalizeTxn after the player authorizes.
godot.Curated.store_stats: Batch StoreStats. `updates` is an array of { api_name, value } and/or { api_name, delta }.
godot.Curated.get_openid_id_token: Mint a short-lived OpenID Connect ID token. Never log it. Returns { ok, id_token } or { ok = false, error }.

unreal.ECuratedLaunchError: Launch contract error. Use UCuratedSubsystem::ErrorToCode for the shared string code.
unreal.ECuratedLaunchError::UnsupportedContract: Contract version below the minimum or invalid. Code `unsupported_contract_version`.
unreal.ECuratedLaunchError::AppMismatch: The launch was for a different app. Code `app_mismatch`.
unreal.ECuratedLaunchError::SessionInvalid: Session expired or the player signed out. Code `session_invalid`.
unreal.ECuratedLaunchError::NotEntitled: The player does not own the game. Code `not_entitled`.
unreal.ECuratedLaunchError::NetworkError: Curated could not be reached. Code `network_error`.
unreal.FCuratedEntitlement: Ownership of one app as reported by `/library`.
unreal.FCuratedEntitlement.bIsEntitled: True when the player owns the app.
unreal.FCuratedSession.AppId: App id the session was verified for.
unreal.FCuratedSession.CuratedId: Public Curated player id (curated_id, 17-digit decimal string).
unreal.FCuratedSession.Language: Raw CURATED_LANGUAGE value from the launcher (en, es, it), or empty. Prefer CurrentGameLanguage.
unreal.FCuratedSession.CurrentGameLanguage: Current game language as a Curated code (en, es, it, pt-br, ...), "en" when unknown.
unreal.FCuratedSession.Entitlement: Ownership details read during the launch check.
unreal.CuratedLaunchContract::ErrorCode: Shared error code string, identical across every Curated engine binding.
unreal.CuratedLaunchContract::ReadProcessEnviro: Launch variables of the current process.
unreal.CuratedLaunchContract::Parse: Validate launch variables for a game whose app id is ExpectedAppId.
unreal.CuratedLaunchContract::ClassifyStatus: None for 2xx, SessionInvalid for 401, HubError otherwise.
unreal.CuratedLaunchContract::DefaultGameLangua: Returned by GameLanguageFromEnvironment when the language is missing or unknown.
unreal.CuratedLaunchContract::NormalizeGameLang: Canonical Curated code for a code, alias, BCP-47 tag or Steam client API name; empty when unsupported.
unreal.CuratedLaunchContract::SteamApiLanguageN: Migrating from Steam: Steam client API language name (english, brazilian, ...) for a Curated code; empty when unsupported.
unreal.CuratedLaunchContract::GameLanguageFromE: Current game language from launch variables: Curated code, "en" when missing or unknown.
unreal.CuratedLaunchContract::GameLanguageCount: Number of rows in the game language table (Full Platform languages of the Curated catalog).
unreal.CuratedLaunchContract::FindEntitlement: Reads a /library response. Returns false when the body is not a JSON array.
unreal.ECuratedMicroTxnStatus: Player decision for one in-app purchase authorization. Error is a Curated failure, not a denial.
unreal.ECuratedMicroTxnStatus::Error: Curated rejected the call or the result was unreadable. Not a denial.
unreal.FCuratedMicroTxnAuthorization: Result of AuthorizeTxn. The publisher key is never present.
unreal.FCuratedMicroTxnAuthorization.OrderId: Order id the game server created with InitTxn.
unreal.FCuratedMicroTxnAuthorization.TransId: Transaction id the game server created with InitTxn.
unreal.FCuratedMicroTxnAuthorization.ErrorCode: Curated errorcode when Status is Error. Zero when Curated did not send one.
unreal.FCuratedMicroTxnAuthorization.ErrorDescr: Curated errordesc when Status is Error.
unreal.FCuratedMicroTxnAuthorization.TransportE: Launch-contract error when the overlay handoff did not complete. None when the overlay returned a purchase result, including Authorized, Denied, and Error.
unreal.UCuratedSubsystem: Curated launcher integration (launch contract v1). Call InitFromLauncher once at startup and wait for OnLaunchCompleted.
unreal.UCuratedSubsystem::InitFromLauncher: Reads launch variables, verifies the player's session, and confirms they own AppId.
unreal.UCuratedSubsystem::OnLaunchCompleted: Fires once per InitFromLauncher call. Error is None on success.
unreal.UCuratedSubsystem::CheckEntitlement: Re-checks ownership during a long session (for example after a refund).
unreal.UCuratedSubsystem::UnlockAchievement: Unlocks an achievement by API name. Safe to call more than once.
unreal.UCuratedSubsystem::RefreshStats: Loads stat definitions and current player values (GET .../stats/progress). ProgressJson is the raw response body.
unreal.UCuratedSubsystem::AuthorizeTxn: Ask the Curated launcher overlay to confirm an order the game server created with InitTxn. The overlay collects the decision. Outside the launcher the result is Error. The game server calls FinalizeTxn after authorization.
unreal.UCuratedSubsystem::GetOpenIdIdToken: Mint a short-lived OpenID Connect ID token for this session. Pass it only to the game's own OIDC consumer. Never log it.
unreal.UCuratedSubsystem::GetCurrentGameLanguag: Game language the player selected in the Curated launcher, as a lowercase Curated code (en, es, it, pt-br, ...). It is the launcher's client language, the same one used to pick language depots. Returns "en" when the game was not started by the launcher, no language was sent, or it is not a Curated game language. Works before InitFromLauncher.
Migrating from Steam: GetCurrentGameLanguage as a Steam client language API name (english, spanish, italian, ...).

rpgmaker.Curated: Global object the plugin registers (`window.Curated`). Use it from script calls.
rpgmaker.@param appId: Your game's app id on Curated (from the developer admin).
rpgmaker.@param quitIfNotEntitled: Close the game when the player does not own it on Curated or was not launched by Curated.
rpgmaker.@param blockedMessage: Shown before quitting when the launch check fails.
rpgmaker.@command unlockAchievement: Unlock a Curated achievement by its API name.
rpgmaker.Curated.CONTRACT_VERSION: Launch contract version this plugin implements.
rpgmaker.Curated.MIN_COMPATIBLE_CONTRACT_VERSION: Oldest launcher contract version the plugin accepts.
rpgmaker.Curated.ERRORS: Contract error codes (`NOT_LAUNCHED`, `NOT_ENTITLED`, ...) mapped to their strings.
rpgmaker.Curated.parseLaunchEnv: Validate launch variables. Returns { ok, error } or { ok: true, context }.
rpgmaker.Curated.GAME_LANGUAGES: Curated game language table: code, English name, Steam API name, aliases.
rpgmaker.Curated.normalizeGameLanguage: Canonical Curated code for a code, alias, BCP-47 tag or Steam client API name, or null.
rpgmaker.Curated.steamApiLanguageName: Migrating from Steam: Steam client API language name for a Curated code (or any accepted value), or null.
rpgmaker.Curated.session: Player session after a successful launch check, else null.
rpgmaker.Curated.initFromLauncher: Read launch variables, verify the session, and confirm ownership. Resolves { ok: true, session } or { ok: false, error } with a contract error code.
rpgmaker.Curated.getCurrentGameLanguage: Game language the player selected in the Curated launcher, as a lowercase Curated code ("en", "es", "it", "pt-br", ...). It is the launcher's client language, the same one used to pick language depots. Returns "en" when the game was not started by the launcher, no language was sent, or it is not a Curated game language. Works before initFromLauncher. `env` is for tests.
rpgmaker.Curated.getCurrentGameLanguageSteamApiNa: Migrating from Steam: getCurrentGameLanguage() as a Steam client language API name ("english", "spanish", "italian", ...).
rpgmaker.Curated.checkEntitlement: Re-check ownership during a long session. Resolves { ok, entitlement } or { ok: false, error }.
rpgmaker.Curated.unlockAchievement: Unlock an achievement by API name (idempotent). Resolves { ok, newlyUnlocked } or { ok: false, error }.
rpgmaker.Curated.refreshStats: Load stat definitions and current player values. Resolves { ok, stats } or { ok: false, error }.
rpgmaker.Curated.setStat: SetStat absolute value. Resolves { ok, stat, previousValue } or { ok: false, error }.
rpgmaker.Curated.authorizeTxn: Ask the Curated launcher overlay to confirm an order the game server created with InitTxn. Resolves { ok, status, orderId, transId } where status is "authorized" or "denied", or { ok: false, status: "error", error, errorCode, errorDescription }. Sends one TCP line to CURATED_OVERLAY_ENDPOINT and reads microtxn_purchase_result. Outside the launcher the result is error. The game server calls FinalizeTxn after the player authorizes.
rpgmaker.Curated.incrementStat: Increment a player stat. Resolves { ok, stat, previousValue } or { ok: false, error }.
rpgmaker.Curated.getOpenIdIdToken: Mint a short-lived OpenID Connect ID token. Never log it. Resolves { ok, idToken } or { ok: false, error }.
